title: Scan QR code
intro: Point the camera at any QR code: classroom entry, late arrival, exit permit, gate, or library visit. The matching action runs automatically.
placeholder: Paste the full code from the QR

results.classroom_entry: Your attendance is recorded in {teacher}'s class.
results.late_arrival_open: Late arrival opened and waiting for the next step.

failures.expired: The code has expired or was already used. Ask for a new QR code.
failures.lateArrivalBusy: Your late arrival is already being processed and is not waiting for a scan.

unknown.bare: Code not recognised. Scan the QR directly, or paste the full code starting with "sion:".
unknown.unsupported: This kind of QR code is not supported.
unknown.missing_instance: The QR code is incomplete. Ask for a new QR code.
